en.value: Energy is the ability to do work. It comes in many forms — kinetic, potential, thermal, chemical, and light.
Imagine lifting a bucket of water — when you lift it, you give it potential energy. When it falls, that energy becomes kinetic.

en.prompt: Name one form of energy you see at home.

hi.value: ऊर्जा काम करने की क्षमता है। यह कई रूपों में आती है - काइनेटिक, पोटेंशियल, तापीय, रासायनिक और प्रकाश।
